slides.say: Use callback caches a function definition between re-renders.
Pass the function and its dependencies. While product id and referrer stay the same, you get back the very same function.
Why? A memo child skips re-rendering only if its props are the same. A new function each render would break that.

slides.text: React doesn’t call your function. It returns it so you call it later.
slides.say: Note: React does not call your function. It just hands it back, and you decide when to call it.
